data.name: Judge SIM 2 Precedent
data.detailed_description:
THE NIGHT SHIFT BEGINS

It is 02:17 in Meridian. An urgent case file lands on your desk.

In JudgeSIM 2: Precedent, you are the judge. Review allegations, examine evidence, hear testimony, rule on objections, and deliver decisions based only on what has been properly established before the court.

BUILD THE RECORD

Information is never free. Opening new material consumes your limited margin, mistakes erode your judicial authority, and every procedural choice becomes part of the record. You cannot click through every option and escape the consequences.

YOUR RULINGS BECOME LAW

Your legal reasoning can become precedent, changing which actions, evidence, and arguments are available in future proceedings. It may later be upheld, restricted, or overturned on appeal.

TAKE THE BENCH

  • Examine layered case files with no hidden “correct” answer.
  • Admit, limit, reserve, or exclude evidence.
  • Question testimony and expose contradictions.
  • Resolve procedural objections that shape the final record.
  • Deliver reasoned judgments with human consequences.
  • Create precedents that alter later cases.
  • Manage scarce resources under mounting pressure.
  • Create and customize your judge.

The truth may remain uncertain. Your responsibility does not.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 o equivalente
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU integrada compatible con DirectX 11 (Intel HD 520 / AMD Vega 3 o superior)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (8.ª gen+) / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
